release_notes: Major interface modernization: replaces the previous Tkinter presentation layer with PySide6, Qt 6 and Qt Quick/QML while preserving the existing Quotation Manager business logic, data model and schema 10.

Introduces the unified Sapphire Light and Sapphire Dark design system with shared typography, spacing, rounded surfaces, semantic Quotation/Proforma/Tax Invoice icons and a collapsible hamburger sidebar.
Adds a shared premium motion system for page changes, dialogs, buttons, navigation and item insertion, with a Reduced Motion preference and stationary-background modal closing.

Improves Quotation, Proforma Invoice and Tax Invoice editors with more consistent field proportions, rounded fixed table viewports, balanced internal table padding, polished focus states and aligned summary/closing cards.
Improves History and Revision History with clearer selection, hover and rounded-table treatment, stable scrolling chrome and more readable line-item revision details.
Improves Templates, Settings, Data & Diagnostics, date controls, dropdowns and dialogs with consistent Qt styling, positioning, focus behavior and Light/Dark theme treatment.
Improves document output quality: Quotation Word content alignment is normalized, and Proforma/Tax Invoice PDF and Excel Terms & Conditions now size and wrap more reliably.

Keeps offline Writing Assistance, templates, backup/restore, crash-session recovery, permanent numbering rules, cancellation safeguards and existing user data/settings compatible with the new Qt interface.

Strengthens OTA certificate handling with Windows native certificate-store verification first and an independent Mozilla CA fallback only for certificate-chain failures; hostname verification, certificate verification and TLS 1.2+ remain mandatory.
Adds a pinned GitHub Contents API freshness check before declaring the app current, preventing stale Raw-cache data from hiding a newer release while failing closed on conflicting security metadata.

Preserves the verified v1.1.3 to v1.2.0 upgrade/rollback bridge, mandatory pre-update backup, installer SHA-256 and size validation, post-update startup/schema validation and automatic rollback protections.

Adds final interaction polish including complete inset focus rings, complete rounded History selection outlines, consistent editor edge spacing and a shared updater status light for checking/current/update-available/error states.
Installer identity, Local AppData paths and database schema remain unchanged for the in-place upgrade from v1.1.3 to v1.2.0.
